🎮 Games kids love

Learning that feels like play. Every game is in the IMALOO app, and you can try a little taste of each one right here. Turn your sound on!

🍎 Fruit Maths Party

Real-looking fruit on a picnic rug in a sunny garden. Children count, add and take away, with a bubbly storyteller cheering them on.

🐣 1-3 count to 10🐥 3-4 add to 20🦁 4-5 up to 50

  • Starts small and grows as your child gets it right
  • Confetti, stars and a Fruit Party for five in a row
  • A gentle count-along when an answer is wrong
Can you count the fruit?
Let's count the fruit!

🔤 Read & Spell

Life-like animals and things to spell, with letters that light up. The storyteller spells along, then reads a little story about each word.

🐣 1-3 first letter🐥 3-4 spell together🦁 4-5 spell alone

  • 45 words, 15 for each age
  • Every word won goes into My Toy Box
  • A little picture story for every word
Pick an animal and spell it!
Pick one to spell!

🎵 Sing-along songs

12 happy IMALOO songs. The words light up as they are sung, and in party mode your child's own toys dance on the screen.

  • Twinkle Twinkle Little Toy, Down on the Farm, Little Blue Dolphin and more
  • Big karaoke words, perfect for little readers
  • Party mode with confetti and dancing toys
Pick a song and sing along! 🎤

All the games are in every plan

Fruit Maths, Read & Spell and Songs are unlimited, with no ads. Little ones choose with big picture buttons, so there's hardly any reading needed.

item.title: How it works
item.dc:creator: imaloo
item.content:encoded:
IMALOO
🏠 Home🎮 Games📚 Books🏰 Fantasy Lands⭐ Prices🧸 How it works🛡️ Safety
Sign in
🧸📷✨📺

🧸 How IMALOO works

Easy steps for grown-ups. Set it up once, then little ones can play on their own with big picture buttons.

👋

1. Make your family account

Go to app.imaloo.com.au and start your 7-day free trial. No card needed. Add your children's names and ages, so the games start at the right level.

📷

2. Add a toy

Tap Toys, then take two photos of a real toy: one of the front and one of the back. IMALOO checks every photo to make sure it's a toy. Photos of people, screens and magazines are refused.

✨

3. Make something magical

Tap Make and choose what to make:

  • Wake-up movie: one toy comes to life and its room turns magical.
  • Adventure picture: up to four toys together in a world.
  • Storybook adventure: in Library, then Books.
🏰

4. Pick a land

Choose one of 54 fantasy lands, from a sunny Aussie beach to outer space. Then watch your toy wake up inside it.

📺

5. Watch it on the TV

Everything you make is kept in the Library. Open a movie and send it to your TV to watch together on the big screen.

🎮

6. Play and learn

Tap Maths, Spell or Songs. Children pick their age (🐣 1-3, 🐥 3-4 or 🦁 4-5) and the games grow with them. Try the games here.

👪

7. The Parents page

Behind a grown-ups question, so little fingers can't get in. Here you can:

  • See your plan and how many movies and pictures are left
  • Choose who can add toys, make movies or delete things
  • Set a daily play time
  • Change or cancel your plan, or delete your account

Questions

What age is IMALOO for?

IMALOO is made for children aged about 1 to 5, with a grown-up setting things up. The games have three age levels.

Can more than one child use it?

Yes. The Two children and Family plans let each child have their own name and age. Tap "Who's playing?" to switch.

Which devices does it work on?

IMALOO works in the web browser on phones, tablets and computers. Apps for the App Store and Google Play are coming soon.

I need help

Email us at support@imaloo.com.au and we'll help.

item.content:encoded:

Sign in
🛡️💖🧸

🛡️ Safe, private and kind

IMALOO is made for little children, so safety is built into every part of it.

Imaloo — where toys come to life and childhood stays innocent.

Imaloo is designed for children to enjoy imaginative, age-appropriate adventures with their favourite toys. Our content rules strictly prohibit pornography, nudity, sexual content, violence, gore, and abusive or disturbing scenes.

Only photographs of toys are permitted. Photos of real people, magazine pictures, screenshots, and other non-toy images are not allowed. Attempts to bring these images to life or create sexual, violent, or harmful content are prohibited.

Our commitment is to keep Imaloo a place for playful storytelling, creativity, and childhood wonder.

How we keep children safe

Nothing scary, no weapons, and toys only ever share hugs and high-fives.

🧸

Toy photos only

Every photo is checked before it is saved. Photos of people, screens and magazines are refused and never kept.

🔍

Everything is checked

Every picture and movie is checked again before your child sees it. If something isn't right, it's thrown away.

⌨️

Children never type

Little ones choose with picture buttons, so they can't type anything into IMALOO.

🔒

Private to your family

Nobody else can see your family's toys, photos, pictures or movies.

🚫

No ads, ever

IMALOO never shows ads to children.

👪

Grown-ups in charge

Choose who can add toys, make movies or delete things, set a daily play time, and delete your account whenever you like.

Read our full Safety Promise Privacy policy

Questions about safety or privacy? Email support@imaloo.com.au.
